operations.details: Verified HMLR Practice Guide 72 development-scheme rules.
Scheme-title aggregation separated from parcel measurement evidence.
Differing title classes retained as legal-registration context.
Verified HMLR Notice 25 Digital Registration Service scope.
Digital submission eligibility not treated as evidence accuracy.
Application transaction schema separated from spatial data semantics.
No scheme or digital workflow inferred exact parcel coordinates.
No registration workflow inferred elevation values.
Both official URLs distinct from prior source registry.
No digital-service metadata promoted to measurement data.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
